name: Space: the card stays over the viewer
why: The viewer opens under the pointer; the card must go, as it does on a click's mousedown. Recorded "pass": Chromium hides the card itself — the viewer covers the resting pointer, the trigger gets its mouseout, and the tooltip engine hides the card (Playwright, 2026-10-24). The _hide() stays, so the card does not depend on that boundary event.
